message.content: Farrah admires Rodri's standout performance in the midfield, highlighting how he effectively contributes to City's momentum and strategy. Specifically, Farrah points out Rodri's ability to "break up opposition plays and quickly transition the ball," emphasizing his crucial role in controlling the pace of the game and setting up City's attack. Farrah also recognizes Rodri's importance to City's success, suggesting that he has become an essential part of their system.
